objective: Pre-deployment audit of Migration 002 and Ouedkniss capture compatibility; no production migration or capture.

recommendation.scope: Do not deploy Migration 002 with the current runner. The additive SQL passes on isolated copies, but there is no atomic, versioned, backup-aware Migration 002 command or compatible rollback path.
recommendation.remediation: Add Migration 002 to the numbered migration mechanism with pre-migration backup, explicit transaction, migration version recording, preflight checks, and post-apply integrity/foreign-key checks. Use verified backup restoration for rollback.

legacy_column_path: extract_price parses the numeric source amount and applies any recognized source-unit scale, then returns no currency.
_validated_price maps absent currency to UNKNOWN and currency_basis=currency_unconfirmed.
process_and_store_data only writes the legacy observation price when currency_basis=source_response, so absent explicit currency the stored price is NULL.
The observation payload retains announcement.price, announcement.price_unit, and announcement.price_type.
price_evidence_path: After source observations are inserted, append_ouedkniss_evidence_for_capture checks whether Migration 002 objects exist.
When installed, it reads each exact-time observation payload and appends one idempotent evidence row keyed by observation, extractor method/version, and evidence index.

For price=1 and price_unit=UNIT it records candidate_amount=1, source_unit=UNIT, unit_status=UNRESOLVED, currency_code=NULL, currency_basis=UNKNOWN, and quality/reason codes rather than a trusted DZD price.
A repeated same-time 1 UNIT pattern across at least three listings is classified SUSPICIOUS_PLACEHOLDER; a single such record is UNIT_OR_CURRENCY_UNCONFIRMED.

lifecycle_findings.retry_after_partial_failure: Failed with table facebook_landing_page_fetches already exists.
lifecycle_findings.migrate_py_rollback_after_002: Failed on an isolated copy with: error in trigger trg_price_evidence_platform_guard: no such table: main.marketplace_listing_observations.

without_migration.result: Capture succeeds, but no structured price_evidence row is stored.

with_migration.result: Capture and candidate recording passed using synthetic fixtures.

absent_migration_risk.recommended_minimal_remediation: Deploy the migration before enabling this sensor version; add an explicit schema-readiness gate so capture cannot silently omit structured evidence. Backfill from immutable observation payloads if any captures occur before the migration.

sequence: Pause capture writers and confirm the exact configured database path.
Create a SQLite online backup to separate storage; verify its SHA-256, integrity_check=ok, foreign_key_check=0, and baseline table counts/source ID fingerprints.
Preflight the expected Foundation V2 tables, Migration 002 object-name collisions, JSON support, free space, and absence of a partial Migration 002 schema.
Use a versioned Migration 002 runner with foreign keys enabled, BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT, and the backup and schema-version behavior described above; do not use the current migrate.py command for 002.

After apply, check integrity_check, foreign_key_check, required tables/indexes/triggers/view, source table counts, and source row/ID fingerprints. Expect zero historical evidence rows because 002 does not backfill.
Run the Ouedkniss price=1 UNIT, missing-price, repeat, and later-capture smoke cases against a separate isolated database copy.

If validation fails, stop writers and restore the verified pre-migration backup atomically. If post-backup captures occurred, export/reconcile them first because restoring the backup removes those writes. Do not use migrate.py --rollback after 002.

rollback_test.recommended_rollback: Restore the verified pre-migration database backup after stopping writers.
